name: Long text over many positions
text: The customer wrote to the help desk about an order that was placed three weeks ago. At first the message only described the delivery, which was late and then lost twice in the same week. The customer explained that the package never reached the old address because the street had been renamed. A neighbour had kept two parcels for a few days and gave them back to the courier without asking anyone. After that the tracking page showed a delivery that nobody could confirm, and the phone line was always busy. The customer then described the content of the order, a lamp, a small table and a set of blue curtains. The lamp arrived with a cracked base, the table was missing one leg, and the curtains were the wrong colour. Photos were attached to the first message, and a second message repeated the same facts with more details. The customer added that the shop had promised a reply within two days and that nobody had written back. They said that they were not angry, only tired of explaining the same story to a new person each time. The writer also mentioned a coupon that had been used for the order and was not shown on the invoice. The invoice listed the full price, the shipping costs, and a service fee that was never explained. The customer asked whether the service fee could be removed because the delivery had failed. A long paragraph followed about the history of the account, which was opened many years ago. Over the years the customer had bought books, tools, gifts for the family, and a few pieces of furniture. So, can I get my money back for the whole order?
